title: make check races parallel website npm installs from a clean checkout
description:
`make check` currently runs `lint-md`, `lint-website`, `astro-check`, `test-js`, and `verify-schema-types` in parallel via `scripts/checks/quiet_check.py`. Each of those targets independently runs `cd website && npm install ...` against the same `website/node_modules` tree, which breaks clean-checkout validation with reproducible `npm` symlink collisions.

Evidence from this worktree on 2026-03-14:
- A clean branch with only issue JSON changes failed `make check` even though the worktree stayed clean before and after the run.
- `test-js`, `lint-website`, and `astro-check` all failed with `npm ERR! EEXIST` while creating symlinks under `website/node_modules/.bin/` (for example `astro-check` and `parser`).
- `verify-schema-types` reported that `website/src/types/game-export.d.ts` was out of date, but running `make verify-schema-types` by itself immediately afterward succeeded on the same checkout. That target suppresses `npm install` stderr, so the generic schema-types error can mask the same underlying install race.
- The race is visible in source: `scripts/checks/quiet_check.py` runs all targets in parallel, and the website-related targets in `Makefile` each invoke `npm install` themselves.

Suggested fix: install website dependencies once before fan-out, or serialize the website targets so only one process mutates `website/node_modules` at a time. Also make `verify-schema-types` surface `npm install` failures directly instead of collapsing them into a misleading stale-types message.
